summary: Forum feature request (topic 'Can you configure a connection to Anytone AT-D878UVII PLUS', 2026-11-21). Owner tried the AT-D578UVIII Plus profile: the radio rebooted harmlessly (driver refuses non-D578 model IDs and leaves PC mode). Same AnyTone serial protocol; different memory map. Plan: official D878UVII Plus CPS REA cross-checked with QDMR's D878UV2 codeplug; read-only driver, website catalog entry and Web Programmer profile.
title: Support the AT-D878UVII Plus (read-only first)
